words.enDefinition: Official authorization to live in a country

examples.en: I checked the number on my residence permit against the copy in my university file.
examples.zh: 我把「居留许可」上的号码和学校档案里的副本核对了一下。

examples.en: The adviser asked to see my residence permit during the registration appointment.
examples.zh: 登记预约时，顾问请我出示「居留许可」。

words.enDefinition: A physical card recording a person's residence authorization

examples.en: I took my residence card to the student office to update my records.
examples.zh: 我带着「居留卡」去学生办公室更新记录。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where my name appeared on the residence card.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看我的名字印在「居留卡」的什么位置。

collocations: the number on a residence card

words.enDefinition: Permission to reside for a limited period

examples.en: The student adviser checked the temporary residence permit against the name in my file.
examples.zh: 学生顾问将「临时居留许可」上的姓名和我档案里的姓名作了核对。

examples.en: I asked which date on my temporary residence permit appeared in the university records.
examples.zh: 我问学校记录里登记的是「临时居留许可」上的哪个日期。

collocations: a copy of a temporary residence permit
the expiry of a temporary residence permit

words.enDefinition: A person's legal position under immigration rules

examples.en: The adviser asked whether my immigration status had changed since the previous semester.
examples.zh: 顾问问，从上学期以来，我的「移民身份」有没有变化。

examples.en: I opened the document to find the section that showed my immigration status.
examples.zh: 我打开文件，找显示我的「移民身份」的那一栏。

words.enDefinition: A stay permitted under immigration rules

examples.en: The adviser asked which document recorded my period of lawful stay during the exchange.
examples.zh: 顾问问，哪份文件记录了我交换期间的「合法停留」时间。

examples.en: I asked the adviser what lawful stay meant in the letter I'd received.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，我收到的信里「合法停留」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: Official authorization to enter a country

examples.en: The officer explained where my permission to enter was recorded in my documents.
examples.zh: 工作人员解释了我的「入境许可」记录在文件的什么位置。

examples.en: I asked how the letter described permission to enter for the invited students.
examples.zh: 我问那封信是怎么说明受邀学生的「入境许可」的。

words.enDefinition: UK immigration permission to stay in the country

examples.en: The UK letter used leave to remain in the section showing my permission dates.
examples.zh: 英国的信在列出许可日期的部分用了「在英停留许可」一词。

examples.en: I asked where leave to remain was shown on the sample from the British university.
examples.zh: 我问那所英国大学提供的样本在哪儿显示了「在英停留许可」。

words.enDefinition: UK immigration clearance issued before travel

examples.en: The UK guide explained where entry clearance was shown on the sample document.
examples.zh: 英国指南指出了样本文件上「英国预先入境许可」显示的位置。

examples.en: I checked the wording next to entry clearance in the letter from the British office.
examples.zh: 我核对了那封英国办事处来信中「英国预先入境许可」旁的文字。

words.enDefinition: The period for which a visa is valid

examples.en: I checked the visa validity period against the dates printed on the notice.
examples.zh: 我将「签证有效期」和通知上印的日期核对了一下。

examples.en: The adviser showed me where the visa validity period appeared on the digital record.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看电子记录上的「签证有效期」在哪里。

collocations: the start of the visa validity period

words.enDefinition: The date on which a visa expires

examples.en: I read the visa expiry date from the screen while the adviser checked my file.
examples.zh: 顾问核对我的档案时，我从屏幕上读出了「签证到期日」。

examples.en: The letter printed the visa expiry date on a different line from the issue date.
examples.zh: 那封信把「签证到期日」和签发日期列在不同行。

collocations: the visa expiry date on a document

words.enDefinition: Requirements or restrictions attached to a visa

examples.en: I compared the visa conditions in my notice with the list in my account.
examples.zh: 我对照了通知中的「签证所附条件」和账户里列出的条件。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to read the section headed visa conditions on the sample.
examples.zh: 顾问让我阅读样本里标题是「签证所附条件」的部分。

words.enDefinition: A code identifying a specific immigration condition

examples.en: The Australian notice showed a condition code beside each description of a restriction.
examples.zh: 澳大利亚的通知为每项限制说明列了一个「许可条件代码」。

examples.en: I asked the adviser where I could find the text for the condition code.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，可以在哪里查到「许可条件代码」对应的正文。

words.enDefinition: A classification of visas by their purpose

examples.en: The notice stated the visa category near the top of the first page.
examples.zh: 通知在第一页上方写明了「签证类别」。

examples.en: I asked whether the term in my file referred to the visa category.
examples.zh: 我问档案里的这个术语是不是指「签证类别」。

words.enDefinition: The person to whom a visa was issued

examples.en: The electronic record showed the name of the visa holder above the reference.
examples.zh: 电子记录在编号上方显示了「签证持有人」的姓名。

examples.en: The adviser checked whether the visa holder and student listed were the same person.
examples.zh: 顾问核对了「签证持有人」和名单上的学生是不是同一个人。

words.enDefinition: An identifying number associated with a particular visa

examples.en: I found the visa number on the document beneath the name of the holder.
examples.zh: 我在文件上持有人姓名下方找到了「签证号码」。

examples.en: The adviser checked the visa number against the number recorded in my student file.
examples.zh: 顾问对照学生档案里记录的号码核对了「签证号码」。

collocations: the visa number on the document

words.enDefinition: The identifier assigned to a particular permit

examples.en: I found the permit number in the upper corner of the residence document.
examples.zh: 我在居留文件的上角找到了「许可编号」。

examples.en: The officer read the permit number back to me before updating my record.
examples.zh: 工作人员在更新我的记录前，把「许可编号」复述给我核对。

words.enDefinition: A visa label placed inside a passport

examples.en: I showed the adviser the visa sticker on the page next to my photo.
examples.zh: 我给顾问看了照片页旁边那一页上的「签证贴纸」。

examples.en: The sample passport had a visa sticker with the category printed near the top.
examples.zh: 样本护照上有张「签证贴纸」，靠上位置印着签证类别。

collocations: a visa sticker in a passport

words.enDefinition: A visa designated for a single entry

examples.en: The words single-entry visa appeared in the heading of the sample notice.
examples.zh: 样本通知的标题里出现了「单次入境签证」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the label showed that it was a single-entry visa.
examples.zh: 我问标签哪一部分显示它是「单次入境签证」。

words.enDefinition: A visa designated for more than one entry

examples.en: The sample showed multiple-entry visa under the heading for the number of entries.
examples.zh: 样本在入境次数的栏目下标出了「多次入境签证」。

examples.en: I asked the adviser where a multiple-entry visa was identified on the record.
examples.zh: 我问顾问，记录在哪里标明了「多次入境签证」。

collocations: the validity of a multiple-entry visa

words.enDefinition: An extension of the period covered by a visa

examples.en: The adviser explained what visa extension meant on the information sheet for students.
examples.zh: 顾问解释了学生说明单上「签证延期」是什么意思。

examples.en: I asked whether the second date referred to a visa extension in my file.
examples.zh: 我问第二个日期是不是指我档案里的「签证延期」。

words.enDefinition: To obtain a residence permit for another period

examples.en: I need to renew a residence permit that expires just before my exams.
examples.zh: 我得「续办一份居留许可」，它刚好在考试前到期。

examples.en: Two students asked where they could renew a residence permit after changing universities.
examples.zh: 两名学生问，转学后可以在哪里「续办居留许可」。

collocations: need to renew a residence permit
apply to renew a residence permit
documents needed to renew a residence permit

words.enDefinition: A passport mark recording entry to a country

examples.en: The registration adviser checked the entry stamp on the page I had copied.
examples.zh: 负责注册的顾问核对了我复印的那一页上的「入境印章」。

examples.en: I found the entry stamp between two pages with older markings on them.
examples.zh: 我在两页带有较早标记的页面之间找到了「入境印章」。

collocations: the date on an entry stamp

words.enDefinition: A passport mark recording departure from a country

examples.en: I asked whether the stamp beside the handwritten date was an exit stamp.
examples.zh: 我问手写日期旁边的章是不是「出境印章」。

examples.en: The adviser looked at the exit stamp while checking the travel dates in my file.
examples.zh: 顾问核对我档案里的出行日期时，看了「出境印章」。

collocations: an exit stamp in a passport
the date on an exit stamp

words.enDefinition: The date a traveler entered a country

examples.en: I recorded the date of entry exactly as it appeared on the official document.
examples.zh: 我按官方文件上的原样记下了「入境日期」。

examples.en: The student office asked which date of entry applied to my current course.
examples.zh: 学生办公室问，哪个「入境日期」对应我现在读的课程。

words.enDefinition: The date a traveler left a country

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the date of departure was visible on the copy.
examples.zh: 顾问问副本上能不能看清「出境日期」。

examples.en: I checked the date of departure on the record before filing the document.
examples.zh: 归档文件前，我查看了记录里的「出境日期」。

words.enDefinition: An official record of a person's entry

examples.en: I checked the spelling of my name against the entry record in my file.
examples.zh: 我根据档案里的「入境记录」核对了自己姓名的拼写。

examples.en: The office asked which entry record corresponded to my arrival last autumn.
examples.zh: 办公室问哪份「入境记录」对应我去年秋天的抵达。

collocations: a copy of the entry record

words.enDefinition: An official record of a person's departure

examples.en: The printed departure record listed a date below the name of the traveler.
examples.zh: 打印出来的「出境记录」在旅客姓名下面列了一个日期。

examples.en: I asked where the old departure record appeared in the online account.
examples.zh: 我问以前的「出境记录」在网上账户的哪里显示。

collocations: a copy of the departure record

words.enDefinition: An official place where people enter a country

examples.en: I saw the name of the port of entry beside the date on my record.
examples.zh: 我在记录的日期旁看到了「入境口岸」的名称。

examples.en: The adviser asked which airport appeared as the port of entry on the form.
examples.zh: 顾问问，表单上列哪个机场为「入境口岸」。

collocations: the port of entry listed on a record
arrive at a port of entry

words.enDefinition: An official who administers immigration controls

examples.en: The immigration officer asked which university was named on my documents.
examples.zh: 「移民官员」问文件上写的是哪所大学。

examples.en: I asked the immigration officer where the reference number appeared on the notice.
examples.zh: 我问「移民官员」，编号印在通知的什么位置。

collocations: an immigration officer at the border
a question from an immigration officer

words.enDefinition: A border official's check of a person's entry documents

examples.en: The handout used entry inspection to describe the document check at the border.
examples.zh: 讲义用「入境查验」来指边境的文件检查。

examples.en: I asked where entry inspection was described in the information for arriving students.
examples.zh: 我问给抵达学生的资料在哪里介绍了「入境查验」。

collocations: an entry inspection at the border
a record of an entry inspection

words.enDefinition: A record or list of previous journeys across borders

examples.en: My travel history showed the two trips I had made during the academic year.
examples.zh: 我的「出入境历史」显示了我那个学年的两次出行。

examples.en: The adviser asked which dates in my travel history matched the previous semester.
examples.zh: 顾问问我的「出入境历史」里哪些日期对应上学期。

words.enDefinition: A document used as evidence of re-entry permission

examples.en: I saw re-entry permit printed above the reference number on the sample document.
examples.zh: 我在样本文件的编号上方看到了「再次入境许可」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether I meant a re-entry permit or the residence card.
examples.zh: 顾问问，我说的是「再次入境许可」，还是居留卡。

words.enDefinition: Evidence of a person's recorded immigration status

examples.en: The university asked which document I was using as proof of immigration status.
examples.zh: 学校问我用哪份文件作「移民身份证明」。

examples.en: I asked how the letter described proof of immigration status during registration.
examples.zh: 我问那封信在介绍登记时是如何说明「移民身份证明」的。

words.enDefinition: The entries specified by a visa field

examples.en: I checked the number of entries shown next to the expiry date on the visa.
examples.zh: 我看了签证到期日旁边标明的「允许入境次数」。

examples.en: The adviser pointed to the number of entries field on the sample visa label.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看签证贴纸样本上的「允许入境次数」栏。

words.enDefinition: An official exception to a visa requirement

examples.en: The university guide explained the term visa exemption in its glossary for visiting students.
examples.zh: 学校给访学学生的指南在术语表里解释了「签证豁免」。

examples.en: I asked which part of the notice referred to the visa exemption in the example.
examples.zh: 我问通知的哪一部分提到了例子里的「签证豁免」。

collocations: a visa exemption mentioned in a notice

words.enDefinition: A new document issued in place of an earlier permit

examples.en: The replacement permit arrived separately from the letter confirming my recorded details.
examples.zh: 「补发的许可证」和用于确认我登记信息的信是分开寄来的。

examples.en: I compared the replacement permit with the scan I had saved before.
examples.zh: 我把「补发的许可证」和之前保存的扫描件作了对比。

words.enDefinition: An appointment to collect identification data such as fingerprints

examples.en: I checked the location printed on my biometrics appointment notice before leaving campus.
examples.zh: 离开校园前，我查了「生物信息采集预约」通知上印的地点。

examples.en: The letter gave a reference number for the biometrics appointment on the first page.
examples.zh: 那封信在第一页给出了「生物信息采集预约」的编号。

words.enDefinition: An office that handles parts of the visa application process

examples.en: I checked the address of the visa application centre against the address in my email.
examples.zh: 我把「签证申请中心」的地址和邮件里的地址核对了一下。

examples.en: The sign near the lift pointed to the visa application centre upstairs.
examples.zh: 电梯旁的指示牌指向楼上的「签证申请中心」。

collocations: an appointment at a visa application centre
the address of a visa application centre

words.enDefinition: An interview held as part of a visa application

examples.en: The message described where the visa interview would take place that morning.
examples.zh: 消息写明了那天早上「签证面谈」会在哪里举行。

examples.en: I wrote down the reference number from the notice about my visa interview.
examples.zh: 我把「签证面谈」通知里的编号记了下来。

words.enDefinition: An official handling duties at a consulate

examples.en: The consular officer asked which institution was listed in my admission documents.
examples.zh: 「领事官员」问我的录取文件上列的是哪所学校。

examples.en: I asked the consular officer which number on the notice we were discussing.
examples.zh: 我问「领事官员」，我们说的是通知上的哪个号码。

collocations: a question from a consular officer

words.enDefinition: Official recording of a person's immigration permission

examples.en: The university guide had a separate page explaining the term immigration registration.
examples.zh: 学校指南用单独一页来解释「移民身份登记」这个词。

examples.en: I asked which office was named for immigration registration in the notice.
examples.zh: 我问通知上说的是哪个办公室负责「移民身份登记」。

words.enDefinition: Additional notes printed on a permit

examples.en: I read the permit remarks because they appeared below the main details.
examples.zh: 看到主要信息下面还有一栏，我就读了「许可证备注」。

examples.en: The adviser asked whether the permit remarks were readable in the scanned copy.
examples.zh: 顾问问扫描件上的「许可证备注」能不能看清。

collocations: permit remarks on the original document

words.enDefinition: The UK immigration route for most international students

examples.en: The university placed the Student route guide alongside the general admission information.
examples.zh: 学校把「英国学生签证类别」指南放在了普通录取信息旁边。

examples.en: I asked which section of my notice described the Student route in Britain.
examples.zh: 我问通知的哪一部分介绍了「英国学生签证类别」。

words.enDefinition: A UK visa for short English language study

examples.en: The guide showed a sample notice for a UK Short-term study visa.
examples.zh: 指南展示了一份「英国短期学习签证」的通知样本。

examples.en: I asked where the Short-term study visa was named in the British course guide.
examples.zh: 我问英国课程指南哪里提到了「短期学习签证」。

words.zhGloss: 英国学习录取确认记录
words.enDefinition: An electronic sponsorship record for UK student immigration
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学习录取确认记录

examples.en: The adviser showed me the course title on my Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies.
examples.zh: 顾问指给我看「英国学习录取确认记录」上的课程名称。

examples.en: I compared the Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies with the university's original offer.
examples.zh: 我把英国的「学习录取确认」和学校最初发的录取通知作了对照。

collocations: assign a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies
issue a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies
check your Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies

words.zhGloss: 英国学习录取确认编号
words.enDefinition: The unique reference for a UK study sponsorship record
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学习录取确认编号

examples.en: I found the CAS reference number in the message from my UK university.
examples.zh: 我在英国大学发来的消息里找到了「学习录取确认编号」。

examples.en: The adviser asked me to read out the CAS reference number shown in the email.
examples.zh: 顾问让我读出邮件里显示的「英国学习录取确认编号」。

collocations: a CAS reference number in an email

words.enDefinition: An account for UK Visas and Immigration services

examples.en: I signed into my UKVI account to read the immigration record on screen.
examples.zh: 我登录「英国签证移民局账户」，在屏幕上查看移民记录。

examples.en: The adviser asked which document I had linked to my UKVI account.
examples.zh: 顾问问我把哪份证件关联到了「英国签证移民局账户」。

collocations: sign in to a UKVI account

words.zhGloss: 英国电子移民身份记录
words.enDefinition: A digital record of UK immigration status
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国电子移民身份记录

examples.en: My eVisa showed the same spelling as the record at my British university.
examples.zh: 我的「英国电子移民身份记录」和英国大学的档案用了同样的姓名拼写。

examples.en: I asked where the dates appeared when I viewed my eVisa online.
examples.zh: 我在网上查看「英国电子移民身份记录」时，问日期显示在哪里。

words.enDefinition: A UK code for sharing specified immigration information

examples.en: The student office asked for a share code to check my UK status.
examples.zh: 学生办公室请我提供「英国移民身份分享码」，以核对我在英国的身份。

examples.en: I asked which share code the UK registration team meant in its message.
examples.zh: 我问英国的注册团队在消息中指的是哪个「移民身份分享码」。

collocations: check someone's status with a share code

words.zhGloss: 英国旧式生物识别居留卡
words.enDefinition: A former physical UK card recording immigration permission
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国旧式生物识别居留卡

examples.en: My old biometric residence permit was in the folder with my previous UK documents.
examples.zh: 我把「英国旧式生物识别居留卡」和以往的英国文件放在同一个文件夹里。

examples.en: The adviser showed a biometric residence permit as an example of an older document.
examples.zh: 顾问用一张「英国旧式生物识别居留卡」举例，说明以前的文件是什么样的。

collocations: a copy of a biometric residence permit

words.zhGloss: 英国学术技术审批证书
words.enDefinition: A certificate under the UK's Academic Technology Approval Scheme
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学术技术审批证书

examples.en: The British university's email mentioned an ATAS certificate in its document list.
examples.zh: 英国大学的邮件在材料清单上提到「学术技术审批证书」。

examples.en: I asked where the ATAS certificate number appeared on the sample my adviser showed me.
examples.zh: 我问顾问展示的样本上，「英国学术技术审批证书」的编号印在哪里。

collocations: a copy of an ATAS certificate

words.zhGloss: 英国学生签证担保机构
words.enDefinition: A UK education provider licensed to sponsor students
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国学生签证担保机构

examples.en: I checked whether the British university was listed as my Student sponsor.
examples.zh: 我查看这所英国大学是不是被列为我的「学生签证担保机构」。

examples.en: The letter identified the Student sponsor in the section below my course dates.
examples.zh: 这封信在课程日期下面的一栏写明了「英国学生签证担保机构」。

collocations: the Student sponsor on a record

words.zhGloss: 英国移民身份核验应用
words.enDefinition: A UK app used for immigration identity checks
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国移民身份核验应用

examples.en: I asked whether UK Immigration: ID Check was the app named in my letter.
examples.zh: 我问信里提到的是不是「英国移民身份核验应用」。

examples.en: The university guide listed UK Immigration: ID Check beside its explanation of identity checks.
examples.zh: 学校指南在身份核验说明旁列出了「英国移民身份核验应用」。

collocations: the UK Immigration: ID Check app
a guide to UK Immigration: ID Check

words.zhGloss: 英国签证语境的学业进阶
words.enDefinition: Advancement in study discussed in UK Student-route guidance
acceptedZhAnswers: 英国签证语境的学业进阶

examples.en: A UK student adviser explained the term academic progression during our document workshop.
examples.zh: 英国的学生顾问在文件工作坊里解释了「学业进阶」一词。

examples.en: I checked where academic progression appeared in the guidance about UK student permission.
examples.zh: 我看了英国学生居留许可指南在哪儿提到「学业进阶」。

words.enDefinition: A U.S. visa category for academic students

examples.en: I saw F-1 visa listed on the information sheet for academic students in the United States.
examples.zh: 我在发给赴美学术课程学生的说明单上看到了「F-1学术学生签证」。

examples.en: The adviser compared the heading F-1 visa with a separate heading for exchange visitors.
